definitions.gloss: attention; heed; keeping something in mind
definitions.explanation: Paying careful attention to a point so as not to overlook it. A formal word typical of instructions, notices, official documents and reports.

examples.english: Bear the following points in mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{留意|りゅうい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧{留意|りゅうい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと。
examples.english: Personal information must be handled with due care.

notes:
Formal and written; in speech ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ or ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is usual.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{留意|りゅうい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pay attention to [thing]
- {留意|りゅうい}{点|てん} / {留意|りゅうい}{事項|じこう}: points to note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: attention, care — everyday, and also used for warnings
- ⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧: consideration — attention to other people's needs or feelings
